description.narrative: The most significant, expected Project-level outcomes are (i) stakeholder effects via increased access to quality middle-income housing and industrial plots (ii) environmental effects via improved efficiency in energy and water usage which will be verified by EDGE or higher green building certification. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates the investment to promote competitiveness in the Indian housing sector by exerting competitive pressures on developers to improve the quality of their projects. The Project will also have demonstration effects on other developers that will be incentivized to expand in smaller micro-markets, adapt their mixed-use business model, and cater to the underserved middle-income populations.

The proposed transaction entails an investment of up to INR 12,840 million (approximately US$150 million equivalent) in the form of subscription to Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) issued by SignatureGlobal (India) Limited (Signature or the Company). The Company is developing an integrated township project comprising of residential houses, commercial and industrial plots located in Sohna, Haryana (the Daxin project). The proposed loan will be utilized to partly finance the development of Daxin project and other future middle-income housing projects in India (the Project).
